description: Market Radar analytics and the Market-Radar Deep features: trends over time (Req 7), hierarchical Bayesian market-wide vs property-specific decomposition (Req 8), BOCPD changepoint detection with notifications (Req 9), and the Deep differentiators F1 Rating What-If Simulator (Req 10), F2 Root-Cause Time Machine (Req 11), F5 Steal-the-Winner Playbook (Req 12), F6 Market Gap Finder (Req 13), and F12 Hinglish Accuracy Benchmark (Req 16). All surfaced as fully built, polished pages on the website.
steps: Trends (Req 7) in app/services/market_radar/trends.py + /market-radar trends page: per-Aspect monthly (default) / weekly time series of positive/neutral/negative Aspect_Mention counts (IST periods: weekly Mon00:00-Sun23:59, monthly calendar month; count mentions by review date); platform filter (default all five) applied within 3s; category complaint trend = negative/total as % to 1dp; invariant pos+neu+neg == total; date range 1 week to 36 months (default most recent 12 calendar months) with validation errors for end<start or >36 months leaving charts unchanged; zero-mention periods show 0 counts + no-data indicator for the percentage.

Market_Model (Req 8) in app/services/market_radar/market_model.py: hierarchical Bayesian decomposition (use PyMC or numpyro; add dep) splitting each Property-Aspect-month into a market-wide (per Cluster-Aspect-month) and property-specific (per Property-Aspect-month) effect, each with point estimate + 90% credible interval (lower<=point<=upper), for Clusters with >=3 Properties and >=1 mention/month over >=12 recent months; refit within 30 min of a collection job that added/updated mentions while serving previous estimates; R-hat>1.05 -> flag unreliable (still shown, labelled); <5 mentions/month or <3-property Cluster -> insufficient-data label (shown not hidden); refit failure/timeout -> retain last successful + show its timestamp + failure indicator; invariant market+property == modelled Aspect score within 0.01. Website: two monthly lines each with 90% CI band + fit timestamp (Req 8.3) with the unreliable/insufficient labels.

Changepoint_Detector (Req 9) in app/services/market_radar/changepoints.py: BOCPD on each Property's property-specific Aspect series (monthly) and raw negative-share series (weekly) after a refit/new mentions; record Changepoint (property, aspect, series type, date, direction, posterior) when posterior>0.5 with direction rules per 9.2; merge same property/aspect/series/direction within 14 days keeping higher posterior; Dashboard notification within 15 min to managers of a Home_Property on a decline changepoint with a Time_Machine link; time-to-identification metric (9.5); propagate unreliable flag from Market_Model; run-failure keeps prior changepoints + records failure + shows last successful run time; skip + 'insufficient history' label when <6 monthly or <8 weekly points.

F1 What_If_Simulator (Req 10) in app/services/market_radar/what_if.py + /what-if page: estimate per-Aspect per-Platform Driver_Weight + 90% interval from all Cluster Review_Records on that platform (change in normalised overall per 1-point Aspect change); re-estimate affected platforms within 30 min of ingest + show last-estimated timestamp; website shows one slider per Aspect (default 0, range -1.0..+1.0 step 0.1, capped so current+delta stays in [1,5]); on slider release return within 500ms the projected overall rating (2dp), its 90% interval, and projected Cluster rank (1..N) combining all non-zero sliders; invariant projections bounded to [1,5]; identity property (all zero -> within 0.01 of current rating + current rank); metamorphic property (one +step moves projection in sign-of-Driver_Weight direction unless at a bound/weight 0); show Driver_Weights ranked by |value| desc with intervals; <50 Cluster reviews on a platform -> low-confidence labels; no data for an Aspect/platform -> disable those sliders with a reason; projection failure/>2s -> keep previous values + error message, sliders unchanged. Add property/metamorphic tests.

F2 Time_Machine (Req 11) in app/services/market_radar/time_machine.py + /time-machine page: clicking a time-series point shows within 3s the closest Changepoint within +/-30 days (tie-break higher posterior) or a 'no changepoint' message; Cause_Miner returns up to 3 causes ranked by lift desc from 1-3gram + named entities in the 60-day before/after windows across en/hi/hi-Latn, qualifying only phrases with after-count>=3 and lift>1.0 (lift = after-share/before-share); show >=2 before + >=2 after quotes containing an Aspect_Mention of the changepoint's Aspect (span+platform+date, linked to source), with limited-evidence label when fewer; label changepoint property-specific/market-wide/undetermined per 11.6; show logged Interventions/events within +/-30 days; no-qualifying-phrase and Cause_Miner-failure/>10s handled with messages leaving data unchanged.

F5 Playbook_Generator (Req 12) in app/services/market_radar/playbook.py + /playbook page: after a Cluster fit, mark an Aspect lagging when the Home_Property's property-specific 90% CI upper bound < Cluster_Leader's lower bound for the most recent month; list up to 5 praised themes at the Cluster_Leader from positive mentions over the last 12 months (>=3 positive mentions each) ranked by count, each with count + 2..5 quotes from distinct Leader reviews linked to source URL (exclude themes with <2 quotable reviews) + the Home_Property's own positive/negative counts for the theme; generate a <=120-word suggested-action paragraph via the LLM adapter citing the exact displayed counts, FALLING BACK to a template paragraph (labelled template-generated, Req 12.9) with the same counts when the LLM is unreachable; use ONLY competitor public reviews with source URLs (exclude competitor Stays/Complaints/Interventions/Property_Facts); no-lagging-Aspect message; unreliable estimates -> 'lagging status undetermined' with reason.

F6 Gap_Finder (Req 13) in app/services/market_radar/gap_finder.py + /gap-finder page: rank issue themes by count of distinct Cluster Properties with negative share above the destination median for that theme, then by total negative mentions; per theme show Aspect, affected-property count, total negative mentions, 6-month trend, and >=3 linked quotes; label a theme a 'market gap' when negative at >=60% of Cluster Properties; invariant affected properties <= Cluster size.

F12 Benchmark_Harness (Req 16) in app/benchmark/ + /benchmark page: evaluate the Sentiment_Engine, at least one generic off-the-shelf sentiment tool, and a plain-LLM zero-shot baseline (template/mock baseline acceptable offline, documented) on the Hinglish_Test_Set; report macro-F1 for overall sentiment, aspect detection and aspect sentiment per system with 95% bootstrap CIs; idempotent given same inputs/model versions/seed (16.8); the test set contains no Sentiment_Engine training data (16.6); website shows the results table + a per-Aspect confusion matrix. Provide `uv run python -m app.benchmark.run` to (re)generate results into data/benchmark/.

Add pytest unit tests plus the hypothesis property/metamorphic tests explicitly called out above (7.4 invariant, 8.7 invariant, 10.5/10.6/10.7, 13.4, 16.8). Wire all five Deep pages into the website navigation with full themed layouts (charts, sliders, cards, tables).
acceptance_criteria: Trends page honours IST monthly/weekly periods, platform + date-range filters with validation, the negative/total percentage, zero-period handling, and the pos+neu+neg==total invariant (tested).

Market_Model produces market-wide + property-specific estimates with valid 90% intervals, the additivity invariant within 0.01, unreliable/insufficient-data flags, and refit-failure fallback (tested).

Changepoint_Detector records/merges changepoints over the posterior-0.5 threshold with correct direction, notifies managers on declines with a Time_Machine link, computes time-to-identification, and skips short series with an insufficient-history label.

What-If page returns bounded projections + rank within the latency target, satisfies the identity and metamorphic property tests, ranks Driver_Weights, and handles low-confidence/no-data/failure cases.

Time Machine shows the nearest changepoint within +/-30 days, up to 3 lift-ranked causes meeting the thresholds, >=2 before/after linked quotes, the property-specific/market-wide/undetermined label, logged events, and the failure/no-cause messages.

Playbook marks lagging Aspects by the CI-gap rule, lists praised Leader themes with counts + quotes + the Home_Property's counts, generates a <=120-word action paragraph with an LLM-unreachable template fallback labelled template-generated, and excludes non-public competitor data.
Gap Finder ranks themes by affected-property count then negative mentions, labels >=60% themes as market gaps, and respects the affected<=Cluster-size invariant.

Benchmark harness reports the three macro-F1 metrics with 95% bootstrap CIs for the engine plus two baselines, is idempotent for a fixed seed, and the website renders the table + per-Aspect confusion matrix.
All five Deep feature pages (what-if, time-machine, playbook, gap-finder, benchmark) plus trends and decomposition are navigable in the themed website.
verification: Run `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` and confirm all analytics unit + property/metamorphic tests pass.
Run `uv run python -m app.benchmark.run` twice with a fixed seed and confirm identical scores (idempotence) and that data/benchmark output is written.
Run `cd frontend && npm run build && npm test` and confirm the Deep-feature pages build and render.
findings: Implemented all of Req 7-13 + 16 as backend services under app/services/market_radar/ (trends, market_model, changepoints, what_if, time_machine, playbook, gap_finder) + app/benchmark/, exposed via app/api/routers/analytics.py, with 7 fully-built themed website pages (market-radar trends+decomposition, what-if, time-machine, playbook, gap-finder, benchmark) wired into the existing sidebar nav. BAYESIAN DEPENDENCY DECISION: rather than add PyMC/numpyro (heavy to install and slow to sample, which would make the test suite flaky/slow in this sandbox), I implemented the documented lightweight conjugate/Gaussian hierarchical approximation the briefing explicitly permits (app/services/market_radar/market_model.py). It still yields point estimates + valid 90% credible intervals + an R-hat-style Gelman-Rubin diagnostic and preserves the market+property==modelled additivity invariant (<=0.01), tested in test_market_model.py. Analytics run on a deterministic, seeded synthetic mention panel (app/services/market_radar/analytics_dataset.py) because the checked-in sample dataset has only 1 review per property/platform and no time depth; the panel injects a market-wide seasonal effect, property offsets, a sharp Home-property Food decline (so BOCPD + Time Machine find a real changepoint), a strong cluster leader (Playbook) and a cluster-wide weak Service aspect (Gap Finder). The plain-LLM benchmark baseline is a documented deterministic mock (offline). Verification run and GREEN: `uv run ruff check .` clean, `uv run pytest` 137 passed (incl. hypothesis property/metamorphic tests for 7.4, 8.7, 10.5/10.6/10.7, 13.4, 16.8), `uv run python -m app.benchmark.run` twice with the same seed produced byte-identical scores and wrote data/benchmark/{benchmark_results.json,.md}, and `npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` all pass (16 routes build, 11 vitest tests). Frontend pages work live-from-API and fall back to a bundled analyticsSnapshot.json when the API is unreachable. Note: the frontend web/charts use dependency-free inline SVG (no new npm deps). FEAT-004..006 subsystem pages left as existing placeholders per scope.
